title: Augmenting Interviewer Judgments of Patient Experience with Automatic Language Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.31007v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how psychiatric patients subjectively experienced a clinical conversation is important for feedback and alliance-related process monitoring. While interviewers form post-session judgments about patient experience, these judgments do not always match patients' self-reports. Automatic approaches for predicting perceived interaction quality from conversation have been proposed, but it remains unclear whether such approaches can complement human judgment rather than simply replicate it. To address this gap, we evaluate a clinician-support framework in which post-session interviewer ratings are combined with automatic language-based predictions to estimate patient-reported interaction quality in free clinical interviews. translated_title: 利用自动语言分析增强访谈者对患者体验的判断
translated_abstract: 理解精神科患者如何主观体验一次临床对话，对于反馈和治疗联盟相关的过程监测非常重要。虽然访谈者会在访谈结束后对患者体验形成判断，但这些判断并不总是与患者的自我报告相一致。已有研究提出了从对话中自动预测感知互动质量的方法，但尚不清楚这类方法能否补充人类判断，而不仅仅是复制人类判断。为填补这一空白，我们评估了一个临床医生支持框架，该框架将访谈后的访谈者评分与基于语言的自动预测相结合，以估计自由临床访谈中患者报告的互动质量。我们在多种标准模型类型上评估了这种整合方式，包括岭回归、支持向量回归（SVR）、多层感知机（MLP）、GRU 和 BiLSTM，所有模型均在从 107 段自由对话的双人转录文本中提取的句子嵌入上进行训练。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个临床医生支持框架，将访谈者的主观评分与基于语言模型的自动预测相结合，以更准确地估计精神科自由临床访谈中患者报告的互动质量，证明了自动语言分析能够补充而非简单复制人类判断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a clinician-support framework that combines post-session interviewer ratings with automatic language-based predictions to better estimate patient-reported interaction quality in free clinical interviews, demonstrating that automatic language analysis can complement rather than merely replicate human judgment.
